text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry!
In front of Trainer, too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"My favorite shojo... I mean, author,
started posting on social media recently!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She uploads illustrations and manga every day,
but she always posts them in the middle of the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I know I could just check it in the morning, but I couldn't help being curious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, b-but don't worry!
I'm making sure to do push-ups while waiting!

...In the end, Mejiro Ryan looked
sleepy the entire day.
